commits_data.title: dfilter: Fix signature of check_relation()
commits_data.message:
dfilter: Fix signature of check_relation()

check_relation() has the argument order swapped from every other
relation check, that's confusing.

commits_data.title: dfilter: Pass a test_op_t in check_relation()
commits_data.message: dfilter: Pass a test_op_t in check_relation()

commits_data.title: ftypes: Simplify fvalue_can_*() interface
commits_data.message:
ftypes: Simplify fvalue_can_*() interface

If an ftype can participate in equala assume it can also participate in
not equals. Use fvalue_can_eq() instead of fvalue_can_ne().

If it can participate in one order comparison it can participate in all.
Replace any comparison with fvalue_can_cmp().
